turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Sunday. How is your weekend going over in Phoenix?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's actually been really nice and quiet. I didn't have to make any trip to the clinic today, so having absolutely zero travel for work has been a great way to recharge.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect Sunday. It's always great when you don't have to worry about a drive. Did you get to sleep in a bit?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I woke up and just brewed a simple pot of regular filter coffee. I know my roommate has that fancy new espresso machine now, but sometimes I just want a classic, straightforward cup.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: There's definitely something comforting about a classic brewed cup. Did you end up baking any sourdough this morning to go with it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No baking today, actually. I kept things super low-key. For lunch, I just pulled out the container of extra dinner I'd boxed up last night and heated that up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Leftovers make for the easiest Sunday lunches! Are you planning on seeing Tom later today, or is it purely a day of rest for you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're actually planning to meet up for a walk later this evening when it cools down a bit. Just a nice, easy stroll.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds lovely. How are you feeling overall lately? Fully back to 100% after recovering from that flu?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh definitely, I'm completely back to normal now. Nursing shifts have been pretty busy, so I'm glad my energy is fully restored.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm so glad to hear that. You definitely need all your strength for those busy day shifts. I hope you and Tom have a wonderful evening walk!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm looking forward to it. Catch up with you later!
